sentences.en: For Julien's sister, having the last word is always a small triumph.
sentences.ko: 쥘리앵의 누나에게 마지막 말을 하는 건 언제나 작은 승리예요.

sentences.text: Le jour de la course, Manon a franchi la ligne d'arrivée en triomphe.
sentences.en: On race day, Manon crossed the finish line in triumph.
sentences.ko: 경주 날 마농은 의기양양하게 결승선을 통과했어요.

sentences.text: En voyant sa sœur bouder encore, Julien se met à soupirer.
sentences.en: Seeing his sister sulking again, Julien starts to sigh.
sentences.ko: 누나가 또 토라진 걸 보고 쥘리앵은 한숨을 쉬어요.

sentences.text: Le coach entend Manon soupirer à chaque série de squats.
sentences.en: The coach hears Manon sigh at every set of squats.
sentences.ko: 코치는 스쿼트 세트마다 마농이 한숨 쉬는 걸 들어요.

sentences.text: Par dépit, la sœur de Julien est partie sans dire au revoir.
sentences.en: Out of spite, Julien's sister left without saying goodbye.
sentences.ko: 홧김에 쥘리앵의 누나는 작별 인사도 없이 가 버렸어요.

sentences.text: Malgré son dépit d'avoir perdu, Manon serre la main de son adversaire.
sentences.en: Despite her frustration at losing, Manon shakes her opponent's hand.
sentences.ko: 진 게 속상했지만 마농은 상대와 악수해요.
